import asyncio


# CASE p_comment_line_before_for expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency(items, width, operation):
    # Run one chunk at a time; each chunk runs in parallel.
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width]))


# CASE p_trailing_comment_on_for expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency(items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):  # one chunk per pass
        await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width]))


# CASE p_extra_loop_after expect=fire
async def map_with_concurrency(items, operation, width):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width]))
    for item in items:
        await operation(item)


# CASE p_extra_before_loop expect=fire
async def map_with_concurrency(operation, items, width):
    await operation(items[0])
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width]))


# CASE p_width_is_items_impostor expect=fire
async def map_with_concurrency(items, operation, width):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), 1):
        await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + 1]))


# CASE p_kwargs_only expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency(*, items, operation, width):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width]))


# CASE p_nested_helper_in_function expect=pass
async def run(rows, save):
    async def map_with_concurrency(items, width, operation):
        for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
            await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width]))

    await map_with_concurrency(rows, 4, save)
